scope__license_tiers.quote: "Registered nurse" means any individual licensed under this Part to engage in the practice of nursing
"Practical nurse" means a person who practices practical nursing and who is licensed to practice under this Part.
"Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a licensed registered nurse who is certified by a nationally recognized certifying body
Certified registered nurse anesthetist or "CRNA" who is an advanced practice registered nurse educated in the field of nurse anesthesia
Nurse practitioner or "NP" who is an advanced practice registered nurse educated in a specified area of care
Certified nurse midwife or "CNM" who is an advanced practice registered nurse educated in the disciplines of nursing and midwifery
Clinical nurse specialist or "CNS" who is an advanced practice registered nurse educated in a recognized nursing specialty area
